<h3 id="posts-title">Posts</h3>

:::{#post-listing}
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  function updateCount() {
    // Attempt to read from Quarto's list.js instance if available
    var lst = window['quarto-listings'] && window['quarto-listings']['listing-post-listing'];
    var count = 0;
    if (lst) {
      count = lst.matchingItems.length;
    } else {
      // Fallback: count visible items in the DOM directly
      var items = document.querySelectorAll('#listing-post-listing .quarto-post');
      count = Array.from(items).filter(el => getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none').length;
    }
    var title = document.getElementById('posts-title');
    if (title) {
      title.innerText = "Posts (" + count + ")";
    }
  }

  // Hook into Quarto's loaded callback
  var oldLoaded = window['quarto-listing-loaded'];
  window['quarto-listing-loaded'] = function() {
    if (oldLoaded) oldLoaded();
    updateCount();
    var lst = window['quarto-listings'] && window['quarto-listings']['listing-post-listing'];
    if (lst) {
      lst.on('updated', updateCount);
    }
  };

  // Fallback observer in case Quarto's loaded event is missed
  var observer = new MutationObserver(updateCount);
  var listContainer = document.querySelector('#listing-post-listing');
  if (listContainer) {
    observer.observe(listContainer, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true });
  }

  setTimeout(updateCount, 200);
});
</script>
